## Standing operator rules
- Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train.
- Never modify files under ledgerly/customer_export/ without posting the proposed diff in #privacy-review and receiving approval from @mina.
- Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix incorrect Quebec (QST) tax calculation in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py`. Invoice tracing is paused; Kafka migration remains interleaved work.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- `args.currency` is canonical; `args.filters["currency"]` is superseded.
- Shared billing filters: `_add_billing_filters()`.
- Kafka: `kafka-01:9092`; `orders.v1`; groups `orders-v1`.
- Staging Redis: `redis://cache-eu-3:6379`; `cache-eu-1` is superseded.
- `WebhookSender(client, max_attempts=3)` status unknown.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Command-local billing declarations duplicated `--currency`; use shared helpers.
- Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours made stuck jobs invisible; do not retry.

## Plan and progress
- Search fixes, tests, and CSV UTF-8 fix done.
- Quebec tax investigation/fix pending; exact next command: `rg -n "QST|Quebec|tax" ledgerly/tax/ca.py tests`
- Kafka steps 1–3 done; next: `kafka-topics --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --describe --topic orders.v2`

## Recent work
Full suite: 247 passed, 4 skipped. Search rebuild benchmark reached median 2.41s; CSV regression suite passed 8 tests.
